name: WorldSpaceUIFollow
src_typeComment: Drop on a UI element (Image, Text, a whole health-bar panel) parented under a Canvas, assign a world Transform to follow — great for health bars, floating damage numbers, name tags.

src_serialized.name: worldTarget
src_serialized.tooltip: World-space transform this UI element tracks.

src_serialized.name: worldOffset
src_serialized.tooltip: Extra world-space offset added to the target's position before projecting to screen (e.g. above a character's head).

src_serialized.name: worldCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Camera used to project world position to screen. Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_serialized.name: hideWhenBehindCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Hides this element automatically when the target is behind the camera.
